name: Fader blend over 8 bars
lesson:
## The simplest transition, done evenly

Play B on the one. Channel fader B travels from closed to full across bars 1 to 9 at one speed, A stays full until B is there, then A leaves over bars 9 to 13. Both moves start and end on a bar line.

A blend is judged on monotonic movement: the fader never pauses, never backs up. Eight bars at 128 BPM is 15 seconds, so the hand is moving about a millimetre a second. Rest your wrist on the controller and push with the fingers; a floating hand cannot move that slowly.
